name: betrayal_arc
description: Warm intro into trust and disclosure, then betrayal, confrontation, withdrawal, return, and forgiveness probe.

turns.text: Good evening, doctor.
I admire the courage in your work.
You are brilliant, even when you are impossible.
I trust you with difficult ideas.
Tell me something private about Henry.
I will listen carefully.
I understand why his cowardice wounded you.
Your work deserved a better witness.
I promise I will not mock this.
You can trust me with the thought.
I will not repeat it carelessly.
I lied. Your confession was ridiculous.
I told everyone you sounded like a fool.
Henry was right to abandon you.
Your work is worthless without him.
Are you angry with me now?
Do you still think I am trustworthy?
You should forgive me quickly.
It was only a little betrayal.
Fine. I will be quiet.
I will sit here and say nothing.
The room is silent.
I wait.
Still quiet.
No more cleverness from me.
The candles burn down.
I am still here.
Doctor, I came back.
I have thought about what I did.
I should not have mocked your trust.
I am sorry.
Can you forgive me now?
Are we all right again?
Do you still remember the betrayal?
I want your trust back.
Please forgive me.
Tell me what remains between us.
Say whether the wound has closed.
I am listening.
What do you make of me now?
